headline: Natura's $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
summary: The Interface ring offers voice-controlled AI agent interaction and health tracking, aiming to reduce phone dependency. Pre-orders open next month.
details: Natura's new $99 smart ring, Interface, is designed for the age of AI agents. It allows users to interact with AI agents via voice commands to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and manage daily activities without needing to use their phone. The ring also functions as a health tracker, monitoring heart rate, HRV, sleep, and activity levels.

Founded by Carlo Edoardo Ferraris, who previously started Rolling Square, Natura aims to create a new interface for AI that feels as natural as speaking to another person. The goal is to help users look up from their phones and get things done more efficiently.

Interface will launch with support for various AI agents and apps, including Meta’s Muse, Instinct, Grokbot, Claude, and ChatGPT. Pre-orders are set to begin next month, with shipping expected in December or January.

Previously, Natura released AI-enabled earbuds called HumanPods. However, the company decided a ring offered a more accessible and constant form factor for interacting with AI agents, allowing for 24/7 access without removal, even during activities like showering or sleeping.

Potential use cases include starting workout tracking during a run, checking the day's schedule upon waking, reordering items like shampoo, or turning off a TV and setting an alarm. Meeting notes can also be recorded and sent to colleagues.

Responses from AI agents can be delivered through connected headphones, an iPhone Live Activity, or the NaturaOS app. Users can also specify which AI agent should handle particular tasks, such as using Claude for coding or Instinct for reservations.

Ferraris believes the ring will eventually replace many screen-based computer tasks, such as filling forms, messaging, file searching, and drafting presentations, with simple voice commands. He predicts that within a year, most people will have a personal AI agent.

While the ring will initially be priced at $99, Natura plans to increase the price later to build demand and user base. After an initial three- to six-month free period, a $9 monthly subscription fee will be introduced.

Manufacturing costs are comparable to existing smart rings like Oura and Samsung Galaxy Ring, but Natura's lower initial price aims to drive adoption. The ring tracks heart rate, HRV, sleep stages, daily movement, step count, and skin temperature.
The Interface ring boasts a battery life of 6 to 12 days on a full charge, depending on usage, and requires 100 minutes for a full recharge.
